name: @loopwithai/monorepo
description: A multi-agent workbench for DeepSeek Harness with Pi, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and the native DeepSeek Agent Loop.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/runtime build && bun run --cwd apps/harness-web build && bun run --cwd apps/cli build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/runtime test && bun run --cwd apps/harness-web test && bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd apps/web test && bun run --cwd packages/network-proxy test && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-selector test && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-pi test && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-codex test && bun run --cwd apps/cli test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/runtime typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/harness-web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/network-proxy typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-selector typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-pi typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-codex typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-claude typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/cli typecheck
scripts.check: npm run build:vendor && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
